# Open Screenshot Generator

> Open Screenshot Generator is a free editor for App Store and Google Play screenshots, feature graphics and preview videos, with its source code public on GitHub. Choose from 101 templates, add app screenshots, edit the layout and export PNGs at store dimensions. The web editor and desktop app share the same design tools, with 57 language options, editable AI results, live collaboration and saved project versions. Design and export run locally. Cloud saving, account storage, collaboration, AI providers and direct store uploads are optional

Key facts

- The editor lives at https://editor.openscrgen.app/. Local design and export need no account, with no watermark, paid tier or export cap
- The 101 templates cover iPhone and Android screenshots, Apple Watch, Mac, app preview videos and Google Play feature graphics. Add app screenshots to see them placed in template previews before choosing a project
- Projects, screenshots and recordings are saved locally in IndexedDB. Clearing browser site data removes local work, so keep a project copy for work you want to preserve. Sign in to use optional cloud saving, or connect your own Google Drive or GitHub account
- Device frames cover iPhone, Android, tablets, Macs and Apple Watch. Real 3D device poses are available for iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, MacBook and iMac
- A project can use 57 language options. Languages share the base layout while keeping their own text and screenshots. Fonts, positions and other drawing properties can also differ for one language, and Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu support text direction from right to left
- PNG export can generate several store sizes and selected languages in one run. The browser saves individual files. The desktop app can save them in a chosen folder with a subfolder for each language
- Preview videos export as H.264 MP4. For App Store Connect, use the mode based on screen recordings at a supported preview size and 30 fps, with a duration of 15 to 30 seconds. Styled videos include the background, device frame and other artwork for websites or social posts. MP4 export needs Chrome, Edge or the desktop app
- The listing preview shows screenshots in App Store and Google Play layouts, in light or dark appearance. A separate comparison view shows the project's languages together
- An optional AI agent can choose a template, place screenshots and draft text in an editable project. Use your own API key, an existing assistant account or the desktop app's built in providers. The desktop app also supports local Ollama and LM Studio, and Claude Code on the user's existing Claude plan. Assistant account mode uses a built in window on desktop or a companion extension and manual copy and paste in the browser. Content sent to an AI provider follows that provider's terms
- Live collaboration lets people edit the same project through an invite link and see the other participants. Collaboration creates a cloud copy and requires sign in. Saved project versions can be restored or opened as a separate project
- The desktop app uploads screenshots directly to App Store Connect and Google Play using the user's store credentials. It can also upload App Store preview videos. Google Play uses a YouTube link for video rather than a video upload
- Desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS and Linux
- The source code is public at https://github.com/dotnetdreamer/open-screenshot-generator

## Pages

- [Home](https://openscrgen.app/): product overview, exported examples, features, templates and FAQ
- [App Store screenshot generator](https://openscrgen.app/app-store-screenshot-generator): the free editor for Apple's store, with the sizes it exports
- [Play Store screenshot generator](https://openscrgen.app/play-store-screenshot-generator): Google Play screenshots and feature graphics
- [App Store screenshot sizes](https://openscrgen.app/app-store-screenshot-sizes): App Store screenshot dimensions and device requirements
- [Google Play screenshot sizes](https://openscrgen.app/google-play-screenshot-sizes): Google Play screenshot dimensions, feature graphics and icon requirements
- [App preview video maker](https://openscrgen.app/app-preview-video-maker): MP4 export for App Store previews and styled promotional videos, plus Google Play video guidance
- [App Store screenshot templates](https://openscrgen.app/app-store-screenshot-templates): 101 free templates for iPhone and Android screenshot sets, Apple Watch, Mac, app preview videos and Google Play feature graphics. Each opens directly in the editor
- [iPhone mockup generator](https://openscrgen.app/iphone-mockup-generator): free iPhone frames and 3D poses, exported at App Store sizes
- [Android mockup generator](https://openscrgen.app/android-mockup-generator): Android phone and tablet frames, exported at Google Play sizes
- [iPad mockup generator](https://openscrgen.app/ipad-mockup-generator): iPad frames for App Store screenshots
- [MacBook mockup generator](https://openscrgen.app/macbook-mockup-generator): MacBook and iMac frames, including 3D poses, at Mac App Store sizes
- [Apple Watch mockup generator](https://openscrgen.app/apple-watch-mockup-generator): Apple Watch screenshot templates and 3D poses
- [AppScreens alternative](https://openscrgen.app/appscreens-alternative): a comparison with AppScreens
- [AppMockUp alternative](https://openscrgen.app/appmockup-alternative): a comparison with AppMockUp Studio
- [Smartmockups alternative](https://openscrgen.app/smartmockups-alternative): a comparison with Smartmockups
- [Previewed alternative](https://openscrgen.app/previewed-alternative): a comparison with Previewed
- [Privacy policy](https://openscrgen.app/privacy): privacy information for the website and editor
- [Terms of use](https://openscrgen.app/terms): plain language terms for the free service
